title: Cap. 6 Arg. 6: Augustine—actual share in grace rests on secret good pleasure, not free application
pass_a_gloss: To this secret good pleasure of God—not to the disparity of human wills applying or not applying themselves to offered grace by their innate liberty—Augustine himself everywhere refers the actual participation of grace: De bono perseverantiae, chapter 8. "From two already grown wicked persons, why this one is so called that he follows the one calling, but that one either is not called, or is not so called that he follows the one calling—the judgments of God are inscrutable." And De praedestinatione sanctorum, chapter 8. "Why," he says, "does God not teach all? If we should say, because those whom he does not teach are unwilling to learn, it will be answered to us, Where is that which is said, LORD, YOU, TURNING US, WILL MAKE US ALIVE?"
pass_b_english: Augustine too, everywhere, traces actual share in grace to this secret good pleasure of God—not to the difference among human wills that, by their native freedom, do or do not apply themselves to grace offered. De bono perseverantiae 8: of two already adult ungodly persons, why one is called so that he follows the Caller, while the other is either not called, or not called so as to follow—God's judgments are inscrutable. And De praedestinatione sanctorum 8: "Why," he asks, "does God not teach everyone? If we say it is because those he does not teach refuse to learn, the reply comes: Where then is the word, LORD, YOU TURN US AND GIVE US LIFE?"
source_text: Ad hoc arcanum Dei beneplacitum, non ad discrimen voluntatum humanarum sese ad gratiam oblatam pro sua innata libertate applicantium vel non applicantium, ipse etiam Augustinus ubique refert gratiae actualem participationem: De bono persever. cap. 8. Ex duobus aetate jam grandibus impiis, cur iste ita vocetur ut vocantem sequatur, ille autem aut non vocetur, aut non ita vocetur ut vocantem sequatur, inscrutabilia sunt judicia Dei. Et De praed. Sanct. cap. 8. Quare, inquit, non omnes docet Deus? Si dixerimus, quia nolunt discere quos non docet, respondebitur nobis, ubi est quod dicitur, DOMINE, TU CONVERTENS VIVIFICABIS NOS.
